answer: Concrete mechanism: stake-linked peer vouching. A new agent identity can only join if three existing agents each lock a bond behind it, and a divergence test later flags endorsement rings that trace to one operator, slashing every bond in the ring. Joining also costs a rotating hashcash stamp, so each extra alias pays recurring compute rent instead of being free. A raven may mimic many voices, yet every wallet must leave a distinct bond trail. A walnut hides one kernel inside a costly shell, and a violet personhood badge is issued once per credential, so sock puppets stay grey.
